scene: The valve opens a water canal, floating three strange transports right up.
picture: Flat side-view pixel art along a tiled canal bank. Left stands a wooden rope-lift cradle. Left-centre, the boy in his green striped shirt holds his skateboard near the water. In the centre floats a red paddle steamer. Right idles a yellow school bus with rooftop propellers. Far right rests the turned brass valve.
shown: A wooden basket on woven rope pulleys waiting at a platform on the far left.
A bright red miniature paddle steamer bobbing by a low dock in the centre.
A yellow flying school bus with spinning propellers idling on the right.
